Pooch Selfie Dog Camera Toy Get Your Dog to Look at the Camera Instantly

This is one of those Shark Tank products that solves a very specific problem: getting your dog to look at the camera for a photo. It clips onto your phone and has a little ball that grabs your dog's attention, so instead of getting a shot of the back of their head or a blurry nose, you actually get them looking toward the lens. If you're the type who takes way too many pictures of your dog (no judgment), this makes the process way less frustrating.
